contentBlocks.text: This week you investigated plant needs and learned how animals help plants. Let's review it all!

Quick review: a fair test changes only one thing (Days 1-2, sunlight and water). Pollination moves pollen between flowers so plants can make seeds (Day 3). Burrs and fruit-eating both spread seeds far from the parent plant (Day 4). Answer: what's the one rule every fair test follows? Name one way animals help plants make seeds, and one way animals help plants spread seeds.
Wonderful work this week — you investigated like a real scientist and learned how plants and animals depend on each other! Next week we'll explore something new.

objectives: Review the fair-test method and this week's two plant-animal interdependence concepts
State the fair-test rule and one example each of pollination and seed spreading
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child state the fair-test rule in their own words.
3. Have the child name one pollination example and one seed-spreading example.
4. Complete the review worksheet.
5. Celebrate finishing a full week of plant-growth investigation!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just one of the three ideas (fair test, pollination, or seed spreading) rather than requiring all three
Ready for more: ask the child to connect this week back to last week — how might a plant's material properties (like a hard seed coat) help it survive being eaten and spread by an animal?
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's three ideas needs the most reinforcement before moving on
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child can state the fair-test rule (change only one thing) and give one correct example each of pollination and seed spreading.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's NGSS Grade 2 Life Science standards 2-LS2-1 and 2-LS2-2 before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.
